subject: What Spiideo, ClutchApp & Jabbr are doing to scale CV annotation
text:
Hi [NAME],

I spoke with [SENDER] Saber recently, who mentioned how your 15-person
labelling team at [COMPANY] is handling frame-by-frame video annotation using
in-house tools. Sounds like you're managing a lot across tooling, QA, and
ops - he thought you would be interested in seeing how Encord is enabling
AI teams to streamline annotation and create better models.

Analytics peers (i.e. Spiideo, MVP, Jabbr, ClutchApp..) to support the fine
tuning of their CV models with the goal of speeding up expansion into new
use cases - particularly focused on agentic workflows to automate their
annotation pipeline as their requirements grow in complexity and scale.

(Series B, $50M raised) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation,
and model evaluation in one platform.

coming weeks? It'd be great to introduce ourselves & get your feedback on
what we're building. We're pretty open this Thur/Fri morning PT, however
happy to work around your schedule.

Congrats on your Series D! Excited to see your vision of becoming the
verified identity layer for the internet coming into reality. I saw you
lead the documents team at [COMPANY], thought to put our upcoming event with
other AI/ML leaders in the Bay Area on your radar. It'll be a small social
mixer on the evening of May 15th hosted by our co-founder -- we'd love to
see you there!

We've booked a private lounge at 25 Lusk from 6:30-9:30pm (catered + open
bar) for 30 industry innovators. Attendance includes CxOs and technical
leaders from Reality Defender, Snap, Physical Intelligence, Archetype AI,
etc.

For context: Encord is a computer vision scale-up working on projects with
Onfido, Veriff & Reality Defender, who are doing similar great things to
[COMPANY]. We focus on consolidating data curation, annotation, workflow
management and model evaluation under one platform.

Let me know if you're interested/free - happy to send over the full details!
